title: Treatment of Dysphagia by Using a Synchronized Electrical Stimulation Device
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the synchronized electrical stimulation device effective in the treatment of dysphagia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* who have dysphagia symptoms and verified deglutition disorder by video fluoro swallowing study

Exclusion Criteria:

* who reject the checkup their deglutition function by high resolution manometry
* who reject apply "Synchronized Electrical Stimulator"
